title: Tool Window owns shell half of transport-B protocol
description: Architecture for the tool iframe communication handshake and why transport-B is centralized here.
body: Owns the shell half of transport B: every tool iframe's hello lands here, and this is the only place that answers ready. Centralising the listener is what makes the security property possible — there is exactly one place that resolves a tool id from event.source, and exactly one map of trusted sources to check it against.
